scope: Mathematical scope audit; no geometric PDE simulation or measured iteration count

radial_map.claim: A smooth invertible radial reparameterization r=rho(eta) retains theta-independent metrics and angular block separation if boundary operators also remain angle independent.
radial_map.qualification: This applies to the implicit linear operator; nonlinear products still couple Fourier modes. Radial conditioning and quadrature can change.

angle_dependent_map.claim: Angle-dependent metric coefficients generally couple Fourier modes in the current representation.
angle_dependent_map.qualification: Sparse direct, assembled, matrix-free, convolutional and iterative representations are choices; PCG and per-product FFTs are not necessary for all geometries.

required_conditions: A is symmetric positive definite on the chosen discrete space
B is a fixed symmetric positive definite preconditioner with exact applications in the stated exact-arithmetic theorem
alpha B <= A <= beta B in the quadratic-form sense is assumed
epsilon denotes a reduction in the A-energy norm of algebraic error, not automatically the relative residual or physical velocity/vorticity error
pcg.implication: For kappa>1, O(sqrt(beta/alpha)*log(1/epsilon)) is a sufficient worst-case iteration scale, not a measured count or lower bound. Kappa=1 gives exact one-step convergence in exact arithmetic.
pcg.not_established: No mesh-independent alpha,beta for arbitrary mapped bodies or empirical nonseparable operator speed result is established here.

primary_reference.author: R. Barrett et al.
primary_reference.title: Templates for the Solution of Linear Systems: Building Blocks for Iterative Methods

boundary_transform_curvature.definition: Bq=chi*q-b*[(chi*q)'']_(z=1), chi=16*z^2*(1-z), b=z^2*(1-z)^2/2; all primes are z derivatives
boundary_transform_curvature.consequence: The homogeneous no-slip constraints do not force inner-wall curvature to vanish. For s derivatives the second derivative has the additional L^(-2) factor.
